programme.title: Melrose Place: Amanda er tilbake
programme.desc: Billy og Kyle presser et redningsteam til å sette i gang en leteaksjon etter Samantha og Amanda, som kan ha fått en alvorlig skade.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Ørkenens Kyle
programme.desc: Cooper og Megan går på date, og Michael prøver å gjøre det samme med stripperen Amber. Bob spiller sin hånd med Peter for å være med Lexi.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Nådestøtet
programme.desc: Lexis far viser sin forakt for Peter. Og Craig truer Jennifer etter at hun får vite om noen ikke-helt-lovlige kostnadskutt.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Mama Mia
programme.desc: Michael og Jennifers mor kommer på besøk og skremmer dem når Jennifer forteller moren at hun var forlovet med Craig.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Siste tog til Bagdad
programme.desc: Kyle og Amanda reiser til Santa Fe for å besøke ekskjæreten hans. Men komplikasjoner truer bryllupsdagen deres når Christine kommer til Los Angeles.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Et slag og en frue
programme.desc: Lexi flytter inn hos Cooper i Melrose og fortsetter å klandre Peter for farens død, på tross for at bevisene sier noe annet.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Stumpt drama
programme.desc: Peter blir innblandet i planen om å ødelegge forholdet til Amanda og Kyle når Christine spiller suicidal og tvinger ham til å få henne innlagt.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Christine på sporet
programme.desc: Etter at Nick og Taylor dreper Christine ved et uhell, legger de liket på togsporet og får det til å se ut som selvmord.

programme.title: Melrose Place: For romantisk for ord
programme.desc: Samantha og Billy har dårlig samvittighet angående flørtene med Jeff og Jennifer. Men lidenskap vipper dem av pinnen igjen når Jeff presser Samantha til å forlate Billy.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Fire forhold og et svangerskap
programme.desc: Michael vurderer drastiske midler angående klinikken. Men innblanding fra en sympatisk Megan får ham til å ombestemme seg.

programme.title: Melrose Place: MP fortrolighet
programme.desc: Etter å få vite at Samantha og Billys forsoning, prøver Jennifer å tenne en glød mellom Jeff og Samantha.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Den sleske professoren
programme.desc: Cooper og Megan reiser til Philadelphia slik at Cooper kan søke på en ny jobb, men dr. Larner presser Megan til seksuelle tjenester.

programme.title: Melrose Place: En dominikansk skilsmisse
programme.desc: Amanda blir med Rory til Den dominikanske republikk for å gifte seg med ham. Hun kjenner ikke til hans plan om å drepe henne og ta pengene hennes.

programme.title: Melrose Place: En lang reise
programme.desc: Peter forteller Lexi at han fortsatt har følelser for Amanda. Lexi får vite at hun kan få skylden for sin avdøde fars tyverianklager.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Et usunt par
programme.desc: Taylor hakker på Michaels forakt for foreldrerollen mens hun fortsatt bor hos ham. Michael begynner å date den nye resepsjonisten.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Vedhenget Jane
programme.desc: Michael drar på collegegjenforening i Chicago for å slippe unna Taylors innblanding.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Det blir ikke verre
programme.desc: Michael prøver å skjule Taylor fra Jane etter at hun blir med ham tilbake til Los Angeles. Men de to finner til slutt ut om hverandre.

programme.title: Melrose Place: God kveld, Mr. Campbell, del 1
programme.desc: Da Amanda blir bortført og det kreves $1 000 000 i løsepenger, tilbyr Peter seg å hjelpe Kyle med å få henne trygt tilbake.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Våpenbrødre
programme.desc: Da Walker og Trivette forsøker å stoppe en våpenhandel, oppdager de at Trivettes forsvunne bror står bak handelen.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Gåter
programme.desc: Mens Walker og Trivette er på sporet av en innsatt på rømmen, etterforsker CD det mystiske dødsfallet til sin venns sønn.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Maktens engler
programme.desc: Walker og Trivette tar en lånehai som utnytter en prests sønn.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Jakobs stige
programme.desc: Walker, Trivette og Alex må beskytte et nabolag mot en gjeng som bruker brann for å skremme vitner og dreper brannmenn.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: I faresonen, del 1
programme.desc: Walker og Alex blir fanget i et flyvrak som synker til bunns i en avsidesliggende innsjø.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: I faresonen, del 2
programme.desc: Walker og Alex har på mirakuløst vis overlevd da flyet styrtet og fanget dem på bunnen av en øde innsjø, men de er fortsatt i stor fare.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Nedtelling
programme.desc: Når en mystisk galning holder byen Dallas som gissel med trusler om å frigi en giftig gass, har Walker og teamet 48 timer på å stoppe ham.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Sikkerhetshus
programme.desc: Walker og rangerne må beskytte en regnskapsfører som har gått med på å vitne mot sin tidligere arbeidsgiver – en voldelig mafiaboss som gjør hva som helst for å få dem til å tie.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Krigerens vei
programme.desc: Walker står overfor en uvanlig utfordring når han reiser tilbake i tid for å etterforske en tidligere urett.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Bra bomull
programme.desc: Gage og Sydney går undercover for å finne Gages savnede søster som blir holdt til fange av en notorisk forbryter.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Lynn-søstrene
programme.desc: Walker og rangerne må redde syngende Lynn's fra en forbrytergjeng som vil tjene millioner på å piratkopiere deres siste konsert – noensinne.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Mistanke
programme.desc: Walker og rangerne må beskytte en døv jente som var vitne til et mafiamord.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Enkemakeren
programme.desc: Når en familie med bøller angriper en lokal rodeo og truer med å drepe Trivette, må Walker trå til for å stoppe noen fra å bli skadet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Kjemp eller dø
programme.desc: Walker går undercover som straffedømt i et høysikkerhetsfengsel i Arkansas for å etterforske vakter som iscenesetter og filmer brutale slåsskamper mellom fangene og selger opptakene på nettet til en heftig pris.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Tid for å levere
programme.desc: Etter at Walker ikke klarer å stoppe en ung gutt fra å begå selvmord på skolen, må han komme over tristheten og sinnet ved å motivere skolen til å bli bedre.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Helt frisk igjen
programme.desc: Walker og rangerne avdekker en plan om å begå et dødelig saringassangrep mot landet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Et spørsmål om tro
programme.desc: I denne juleepisoden må Walker og teamet finne gjerningspersonene som stjal gaver til vanskeligstilte barn fra en lokal kirke og etterlot pastoren i koma.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Åndelig reise
programme.desc: Walker står overfor formidable fiender, både indre og ytre, når en bombeeksplosjon skader øynene hans.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: En prinsippsak
programme.desc: Walker og rangerne må finne en gjeng smykketyver som har skadet en tidligere rangers datter under et grovt ran.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Thunderhawk
programme.desc: Walker og rangerne må finne en sofistikert og dødelig sonisk laser når den havner i gale hender.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-eksperten Friar finner en bombe festet til stolen sin, og en hacker beordrer ham til å stjele digitale penger. Snart må Friar kjempe for å renvaske navnet sitt - uten å bli sprengt i fillebiter.

programme.title: Hjemme i Hampstead
programme.desc: En amerikansk enke i London innleder et forhold til en mann som oppholder seg i Hampstead Heath, men en hensynsløs entreprenør vil få ham vekk derfra.

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den avdankede sheriffen i en liten by i Georgia, Ben Watts, blir presset til raskt å løse en gisselsituasjon – og innser snart at han er en brikke i et større spill blant byens skumle hemmeligheter.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: En kompromissløs mestertyv blir forrådt av medhjelperne og overlatt for å dø. Han utgir seg for å være en annen og samarbeider med en kvinne på innsiden for å sikre seg det seneste kuppet til gjengen.

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Et kapret fly vil styrte om bare 97 minutter når det går tom for drivstoff. NSA-direktøren vil at flyet skal skytes ned før den tid, og overlater skjebnen til de uskyldige passasjerene til en hemmelig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA-agenten Robert bor på et hemmelig feriested for tidligere spioner. Nå er hans sønn Paul havnet i trøbbel og trenger hans hjelp. Dessverre er ikke Pauls planer så hemmelige som livet til faren.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensjonerte CIA-agenten Robert legger ut på en dristig redningsaksjon av erkefiendens enke, Sasha. Men snart blir Robert konfrontert med et kjent ansikt han trodde han aldri ville se igjen...

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Etter en romantisk kveld i deres avsidesliggende hus, våkner Emma opp lenket til sin døde ektemann. Hun er fanget og isolert og må kjempe mot leiemordere for å unnslippe ektemannens avsindige plan.

programme.title: Official Secrets
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om en britisk varsler som lekket informasjon til media om en ulovlig NSA-operasjon, hvis formål var å presse FNs sikkerhetsråd til å godkjenne invasjonen av Irak i 2003.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: Når en amerikansk by blir invadert av nordkoreanske soldater, kommer en gruppe unge mennesker sammen for å beskytte hverandre, frigjøre byen og gjenvinne sin frihet.

programme.title: Wildfire: Taking Off
programme.desc: Kris learns a lesson in the jockey life as she works under a renowned but demanding trainer.

programme.title: Wildfire: Fear
programme.desc: Kris must turn to Junior for help when she is asked to throw a race by John Zack, the figure from Pablo's past.

programme.title: Wildfire: Break Down
programme.desc: Kris finds herself racing Dani's horse Picaro against Wildfire, as the result of a promise she made.

programme.title: Wildfire: 51/49
programme.desc: Kris deals with crisis of confidence after events of pile-up, as Junior and Dani find out startling news about their father, Matt struggles with revealing info regarding the cause of pile-up with Kris

programme.title: Wildfire: Who Are You?
programme.desc: Kris must woo an influential heiress in hopes of getting Wildfire, and not Dani's horse Ishmael, selected for the Breeders Invitational Stakes.

programme.title: Wildfire: For Love Or Money?
programme.desc: Kris must choose between an opportunity to win a spot in the Breeders Invitational Stakes and caring for an in-labor Belladonna.

programme.title: Wildfire: Close Shave
programme.desc: Kris is reunited with Wildfire in time to race on the world's biggest stage, in the Breeders Invitational Stakes.

programme.title: Wildfire: Fairy Tale Endings
programme.desc: In the third-season premiere, Kris learns what happened to Kerry while Raintree deals with the unexpected fallout of the Breeders' Cup win.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Feud
programme.desc: Kris resorts to desperate measures to ease Raintree's financial crisis.

programme.title: Wildfire: Moving On
programme.desc: Kris has a falling-out with Jean over Wildfire's readiness to race again.

programme.title: Wildfire: Close To Home
programme.desc: The destruction of Kris's trailer by fire forces her to move into the Ritters' house, which brings her closer to an old flame.

programme.title: Wildfire: Love Vs. Work
programme.desc: Kris is distracted by the return of her rival, Tina Sharp (Amy Jo Johnson), who is tapped to ride a Raintree boarder's horse that used to belong to the Davis ranch.

programme.title: Wildfire: Kiss Kiss
programme.desc: Kris is overcome by emotion when she helps Matt and Junior try to save Flame from being sold by Junior's dad.

programme.title: Wildfire: Push Me/Pull You
programme.desc: Kris worries about her status at Raintree after Gillian moves into the bunkhouse with Matt and begins offering unsolicited advice about Wildfire's training.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Good-Bye
programme.desc: With Raintree in dire financial straits, Jean and Matt's willingness to consider a buyer's offer draws criticism from Pablo and Kris.

programme.title: Wildfire: Heartless
programme.desc: Kris increasingly becomes the object of Matt's affection; this renders his relationship with Gillian incompatible.

programme.title: Wildfire: Diplomacy
programme.desc: Kris and Matt's rekindled relationship comes as a shock to Junior, who is distracted by consoling Dani in her time of mourning.

programme.title: Wildfire: You Can't Count On Me
programme.desc: Kris' endeavors to get accustomed to her new relationship with Matt and deal with Pablo's departure are interrupted by a surprise visit from her half brother (Ignacio Serricchio).

programme.title: Wildfire: Picking Sides
programme.desc: Kris tries to repair the rift between Matt and Junior, but the tension is exacerbated by the approach of the important Bristol Stakes and the return of Gillian, who proceeds to resume her bonding with Junior.

programme.title: Wildfire: So Long, Pardner
programme.desc: In the third-season finale, Kris and Matt weigh a generous offer from Sheik Omar that would go a long way toward easing Raintree's financial woes---but that also may be against the law.

programme.title: On the Case: Murder at Sunrise
programme.desc: A beautiful young mother is found murdered while walking her dogs. Investigators suspect her killer is someone she knew. Twenty-six years latter police make an arrest but is he the right man?

programme.title: On the Case: A Mother's Nightmare
programme.desc: A young boy is murdered in his bed in the middle of the night. Police suspect the child's mother. Over the next 9 years there will be accusations, a confession and a conviction but will justice be served?

programme.title: On the Case: Veil of Suspicion
programme.desc: A beloved husband and father is found executed in front of his home.

programme.title: On the Case: Twice Is No Accident
programme.desc: When Fran Smith mysteriously disappears her sister and daughter mount their own investigation... What they uncover sends police on a cross country man hunt for a killer.

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer Among Friends
programme.desc: When a teenager is found savagely murdered, police must retrace her last steps alive to identify her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: A Promise Kept
programme.desc: A cold-case detective reopens a decades-old murder case and promises to get justice on behalf of the victim's family.

programme.title: On the Case: Evidence of Deception
programme.desc: When a beautiful college coed is found dead in her dorm room police discover a crime scene where nothing is what it appears to be.

programme.title: On the Case: A Nightmare in Idaho Falls
programme.desc: Reeda Roundy and Betty Gray are found murdered in Roundy's home, along with a message written in blood, saying `Satan Loves You'. Detectives piece together the stunning truth behind the murders with insights provided by the victims' families.

programme.title: On the Case: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A small town hair dresser is found beaten and strangled in her beauty salon. After the investigation goes cold, an act of conscience cracks the case.

programme.title: On the Case: She Wasn't Alone
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman is viciously murdered just 24 hours after she was engaged to be married.

programme.title: On the Case: A Terrible Secret
programme.desc: A bed sheet may prove to be the key to solving the murder of a 13-year-old girl who is found strangled on a riverbank.

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer in the Sun
programme.desc: When Kenny Baker returns home, the backdoor is ajar and his wife, Kathy, and two-year-old son, Ryan, are nowhere to be found.

programme.title: On the Case: Tracks of a Killer
programme.desc: Police retrace a young woman's final movements with hope that it will lead them straight to her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: Blood, Sweat and Tears
programme.desc: A cold case team reopens the investigation into the murder of 36-year-old Linda Robinson who is savagely murdered while her seven-year-old niece is asleep in the next room.

programme.title: On the Case: A Murder in Pelham
programme.desc: A daughter spends 25 years pursuing the truth behind her mother's mysterious murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Trail of Tears
programme.desc: A young woman's mysterious murder sends detectives on a heartbreaking search for the truth.

programme.title: On the Case: At Death's Door
programme.desc: After a single mother is viciously attacked and left for dead, she still manages to help police track down her assailant.

programme.title: On the Case: A Murder at Loose Chippings
programme.desc: After a wealthy couple is found dead in their stately Virginia home, investigators are taken on a wild journey around the globe before they uncover the shocking truth.

programme.title: On the Case: Innocent Witness
programme.desc: When Rhonda Boggs is discovered murdered in her own kitchen, police get an important lead from the only witness to the crime, Rhonda's two year old daughter.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Turkey or Bust
programme.desc: Justin and Cory are stranded in Croatia while trying to complete the delivery of two CL-215 water bombers to Turkey.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Cold Start
programme.desc: Mikey links up with Chris Hadfield aboard the International Space Station. Problems mount while trying to get a frozen DC-4 airborne. A landing gear collapse on the runway sends the entire crew scrambling.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Shootout
programme.desc: Rookie co-pilot David faces a remote Arctic airstrip with sketchy landing gear. Mikey drafts a Buffalo hockey team to face off against an NHL squad in a charity shootout. Chuck gets a chance to shine on the ice.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Snowplane
programme.desc: Joe races a quirky antique snowmobile - with an airplane engine and no brakes. The water bomber crew struggles to get two planes out of Turkey. Cocky rampie Chris Staples tries to prove himself in the C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Gear Lock
programme.desc: A cold snap triggers massive challenges. Devan runs into gear problems while he ferries a mothballed DC-3 across the country. And Justin has to make a snap decision with his newborn son aboard his plane.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Aussie Ace
programme.desc: The Electra returns from repairs and the crew takes it right back to the ice strip that it set off from before the crash landing last year. Tyler works up the courage to confront Joe about a big decision. A hotshot Australian pilot tries to earn a job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Rock Stars and Rampies
programme.desc: Facing Joe's wrath, Rod and Cory head to the UK to make urgent water bomber repairs. David tries to prove himself to Devan in the C-46 but ends up infuriating Devan. Will makes an ultimatum in Hay River.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Camp
programme.desc: Mikey trains for High Arctic survival with the Canadian Rangers. The Air Force invades Chuck's hangar. Joe faces tough competition at a California plane auction.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Solid
programme.desc: AJ and James battle a DC-4 engine fire. It's Joe's 69th birthday - and he's never flown a helicopter before, so Mikey plans a special gift of chopper flight lessons.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Power Crash
programme.desc: Cory, Chuck and Brian watch as a 5,000-pound power unit smash to the ground, denting the Electra and putting it out of commission. Mikey scrambles to manage the crisis while Joe races to England to try and purchase a backup Electra.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Breakdown
programme.desc: Co-pilot Graeme's fumbles his Electra training landings. Chris stresses over his C-46 check ride. Adam rescues a stranded C-46.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Target Practice
programme.desc: Joe and Mikey head to England to bring home a new plane. Devan does target-practice in the DC-4.James builds a Buffalo-style soapbox racer.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Air Show
programme.desc: Joe flies with the Snowbirds during the Hamilton air show and later teaches Mikey to fly. A surprise departure shakes up Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Five Seasons
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWT celebrates a milestone with a look back at the last five years, a peek behind the camera and reflections from the Buffalo crew.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Ball O'Snags
programme.desc: An engine fire and series of mechanical gremlins has Buffalo scrambling to make its Christmas deliveries. Newest rampie Prefkar Mony struggles with life in the North.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Storm
programme.desc: Buffalo's Electra aircraft is hammered by rough winds up the Mackenzie Valley. In Hay River, a rookie crew faces the worst ice storm in years and one rampie has a tough go trying to fit in at Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Old Dogs
programme.desc: Engine trouble plagues Buffalo's newest Electra, ZFE, and a standoff between Joe and Transport Canada threatens to close the airline. At the same time, Joe faces a tough decision about his old dog Sophie.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Checkflight
programme.desc: Joe leaves to undergo medical tests at the Mayo Clinic in Phoenix, Arizona. Jeff and Sam stress over their DC-3 checkflights and Joe celebrates turning 70-his way.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Second Chances
programme.desc: Rookie pilot Jeff nearly runs off the runway. Prefkar learns to play hockey but drops the ball at Buffalo and Joe goes on a date with a real dog.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Big Plans, Bad Luck
programme.desc: Mikey decides to get Buffalo involved in a D-Day paratrooper jump to commemorate the 70th anniversary of D-Day. Prefkar escapes Hay River courier duty. Cory finds an original bracket for the DC3 static line for Mikey's D-Day jump.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Bowling Pin Payday
programme.desc: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Ruff Day
programme.desc: Ton and Allen head to an auction in Ton's hometown and end up battling with a big-mouthed buyer. They discover a pair of tranquilizer dart guns and also end up fighting with a K9!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Little-Ton Jones
programme.desc: Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Easy Money
programme.desc: Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Half Pipe Dreams
programme.desc: 1970s Z-Flex Jimmy Plumer Poolrider skateboard with artwork by Doug Smith; Kevlar bulletproof vest, ballistic facemask and a helmet used by S.W.A.T. teams; a pair of 1990s racing pocket bikes capable of going 80 mph.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sink or Swim
programme.desc: 1905 Hand-crank Thomas Edison gramophone with cylindrical records; a discontinued Addictor 190 Mini Boat; a rare 1897 Regina music box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Mr. Haff Goes to Washington
programme.desc: Ton and Allen invade the Nation's capital, but meet strong resistance from local bidders. The guys uncover a Civil War era black powder revolver and a stash of South African gold coins!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Diesel Digs
programme.desc: The guys head to the industrial hub of LA to score some heavy machinery and unearth a 1981 Bobcat 743 Frontloader, one of the first powered by a diesel engine and a trench-defending WWI German Sturmtrupp helmet bashing mace.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Real Thing
programme.desc: Allen and Ton compete with a notorious deep-pocketed bidder in Oxnard, CA, and score a vintage Coca-Cola vending machine, a vintage desk and a rare 1971 GMC truck.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Driller Instinct
programme.desc: Ton & Allen encounter aggressive outdoorsmen in the Alaskan wilderness. The guys discover an 8-wheeled ATV that travels on both land & water and an air percussion hammer that can drill through solid rock!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead
programme.desc: A custom-built shark cage; 1900s pathologist's dissection toolkit; 1940s embalming pump and one of the first electric bone saws.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
programme.desc: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fire in the Hole!
programme.desc: 1930s "blasting machine" dynamite detonator box; 1890s treasure chest with secret compartments. Ton smelts jewelry to forge bricks of silver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Disco and Dice
programme.desc: 1978 Williams Disco pinball machine; 1898 dice popper gambling device; talking 1990s bar top breathalyzer; deadly fishing harpoon.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Dallas Mavericks
programme.desc: Military-grade Tomahawk cruise missile jet engine; century-old handcrafted wild west cowboy saddle; 1960s high roller's gold money.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Great American Cashtime
programme.desc: Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Weapons of Past Destruction
programme.desc: Knowing that Hollywood auctions are hit-and-miss, Allen and Ton buy inexpensive lockers that contain a polygraph machine, a samurai sword and a pair of Civil War shotguns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Cold Hard Cash
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sin City Shootout
programme.desc: 1953 Chevy-inspired bumper car; scores of M16 30-round magazines; reproduction 1940s boardwalk photobooth; aerosol-powered spud gun potato launchers.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Top Gun Ton
programme.desc: Scale RC Viper FanJet aircraft with a potent jet engine; 1920s Gundlach Korona large format field camera used for photography expeditions. Ton pilots a plane, but crashes and burns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Battle Bought
programme.desc: Mint 1800s French "Harmonica Pistol" and a collection of '90s remote controlled combat robots.

programme.title: Vilterian: Köttbullar
programme.desc: Denna vecka lagar Johan Bergquist köttbullar i smarrig tomatsås - på grillen! Detta serveras på en råraka och avnjuts med fördel riktigt kladdig i slaktarpapper!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Jakt I Tjeckien - Del 1
programme.desc: Jompen med vänner åker till Tjeckien för att fira Jakt är Jakt två-årsjubileum. Efter en vilodag i Prag åker dom söder ut för drevjakt på Vildsvin och Kronhjort.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Drevjakt Med Filip / Drevjakt I Polen (Watershed)
programme.desc: Filip är på en prövande och spännande drevjakt i mindre optimalt väder i Örbyhus. / Jompen åker på en väldigt framgångsrik drevjakt i Polen. Massa djur på fina marker utlovas!
programme.sub-title: Drevjakt Med Filip / Drevjakt I Polen (Watershed)

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Jakt Och Matlagning Med Calle
programme.desc: Jompen beger sig till Skåne för att jaga och laga. Calle välkomnar återigen Jakt är Jakt till en fantastisk och oförglömlig helg. Frasig fasan står på menyn. Mer vilt åt folket - vi är vilterianer!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Dovpyrsch på Ridön
programme.desc: Vi återvänder ännu en gång till Ridön, en av våra absoluta favoritplatser när det kommer till jakt! Den här gången följer Simon med för en smygjakt på vildsvin och dovhjort.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Drevjakt På Ringsö
programme.desc: För första gången samlas hela jakt är jakt för drevjakt på en av Sveriges dovhjortstätaste marker, Ringsö.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Bockpremiär & Filip Är På Drevjakt
programme.desc: Nu ger sig gänget iväg för en händelserik bockpremiär!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Vi Lagar Chili
programme.desc: Jompen tillagar chili con carne på vildsvin. Pierre och Mats kommer förbi och njuter av resultatet - och svarar på tittarfrågor.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Årets sista drevjakt
programme.desc: Årets sista drevjakt. Två dagar magi på marker med hutlöst mycket vilt!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Drevjakt I Vibyholm
programme.desc: Jompen är ute på en minst sagt händelserik drevjakt på Vibyholm i Sörmland. Massa vilt, missa inte!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Drev- Och Gåsjakt I Skåne
programme.desc: Jompen åker till Blommeröd för drevjakt & gåsjakt med Calle Dreyer!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Pulled Pork
programme.desc: Lubbe och Jompen lagar Pulled Pork Sliders a lá Sous Vide på karré från vildsvin. Vildsvinet kommer från höstens jakter.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Lockjakt på älg
programme.desc: Jompen sticker upp till Norrbotten för lockjakt på älg! Det är inte helt lätt men tillslut lossnar allt. En riktigt minnesvärd jakt i magiskt landskap utlovas!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Jompens Första Vilt
programme.desc: Jompen skjuter sin första hjort efter att ha klarat jägarexamen på Jägareförbundet.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Dovpyrsch & Jompen Och Stoffe Jagar
programme.desc: Jompen pyrschar dov med Jägaren och Kocken.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Best Of 2020
programme.desc: Den här veckan visar vi upp några av våra bästa jaktsekvenser från 2020!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Kronpyrsch i Skåne
programme.desc: Jompen åker på drevjakt samt pyrschjakt på kron nere i Skåne. Väl där möter han upp Danne och Calle Dreyer för att både jaga och laga mat. Grymt lyckad jakt på viltrik mark!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Ripjakt
programme.desc: Lubbe och Jompen åker till Klimpfjäll i södra Lappland för att jaga ripa.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Drömpyrsch
programme.desc: Jompen smyger på räv, dovhjort och vildsvin. Fantastisk vacker dag med skare som försvårar Jompens skottmöjligheter.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Första Drevjakten För Året
programme.desc: Jompen och Mats är på årets första drevjakt 2017. Rådjursjakt med hagel står på schemat och vi befinner oss utanför Stockholm.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Askas Första Klövvilt
programme.desc: Jompen och Christoffer tränar och jagar med Aska i nästan ett års tid. Nu är tiden mogen att fälla Askas första klövvilt i hägnet på Almunge Hundcenter.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Drevjakt I Vinterskog & Jompens Första Hjort
programme.desc: Lubbe och teamet kämpar i snöväder och kyla i jakten på hjort och rådjur när en majestätisk älg plötsligt stegar fram ur buskagen.
programme.sub-title: Drevjakt I Vinterskog & Jompens Första Hjort

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Årets Bästa Drevjakt - 16 Vilt!
programme.desc: Jompen & Danne beger sig till Sörmland för två dagars drevjakt. Resultatet blir minst sagt något utöver det vanliga!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Jompen Och Danne På Skoveljakt
programme.desc: Jompen och Danne är och jagar skovel i Sörmland. Det blir en episk film och en mycket lyckad jakt för båda två.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Nya Jägare
programme.desc: Danne är bjuden på en drevjakt som Sveaskog håller i samarbete med jägareförbundet, där nyexaminerade jägare för testa på att jaga. Lärorikt och spännande situationer i veckans drevjakt!

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Gäddjakt I Roslagen & Jakt På Vildren
programme.desc: Jompen ger sig ut på en ny slags jakt i Roslagen.
programme.sub-title: Gäddjakt I Roslagen & Jakt På Vildren

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Jakt Och Skogslära
programme.desc: Jompen beger sig till Götaland för att jaga och besöka Anna Stridsman, skogsvårdschef på Svea Skog, för att lära sig om betesskador och sättet markägare ser på jakten.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Foderplats
programme.desc: Jompen bygger sin första foderplats för att locka vildsvinen från åkrarna.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Pierre Skjuter 4 Vildsvin
programme.desc: Under vår och tidig sommar jagar Pierre väldigt mycket vildsvin i spannmålen, i det här avsnittet tar han med oss på en samling spännande jakter han har varit med om.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Jakt På Ringduva
programme.desc: Lubbe jagar ringduva i Uppland helt ensam. Trodde han tills filmteamet dök upp.

programme.title: Jakt är Jakt: Jompens Första Drevjakt

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Play
programme.desc: With Phelps and Rollin as the leading men, the Impossible Missions Force stages an anti-American play which could prove to be a strong propaganda device for the enemy.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Cardinal
programme.desc: An army commander (played by guest star Theodore Bikel) plots to become dictator by imprisoning an influential cardinal and using a look-alike actor for a public endorsement.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Elixir
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force offers a "fountain of youth" to the vain and dictatorial widow (guest star Ruth Roman) of the late president of a small South American country in order to depose her.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Exchange
programme.desc: Cinnamon is captured and the enemy discovers the one thing that would unmask her identity and expose the Impossible Mission Force.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bargain
programme.desc: The former dictator of a Caribbean island is made to have hallucinatory visions in which he sees his ominous destiny as part of an ingenious plot designed by the Impossible Missions Force.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Mind of Stefan Miklos
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force is pitted against the ingenious logic of an enemy agent (guest Steve Ihnat) as the IMF attempts to lead the agent through a maze of complicated clues in order to reach a false conclusion.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Freeze
programme.desc: Before a statute of limitations expires on a 10-million dollar robbery, the Impossible Missions Force must spring the suspect from prison and dupe him into leading police to the hiding place of the money.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Test Case
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force must end the murderous career of a bacteriologist working for the enemy, who has succeeded in developing a mutant strain of a deadly bacteria which could be used as a practical battlefield weapon.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The System
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force led by Jim Phelps (Peter Graves) sets out to persuade the trusted henchman of a crime syndicate leader to testify against his boss.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Glass Cage
programme.desc: An electronically guarded prison confronts the Impossible Missions Force when it tries to free a political prisoner (Richard Garland) from an escape-proof glass cell.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Live Bait
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force invades the intricate world of spies to protect an American double agent and comes up against a human time bomb.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Doomsday
programme.desc: When an unscrupulous manufacturer risks World War III by offering a hydrogen bomb for sale, the Impossible Missions Force enters the bidding with a dangerous plan to keep the weapon out of enemy hands.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bunker, Pt. 1
programme.desc: The IMF races a paid killer who is stalking a nuclear scientist forced by the enemy to work on a device that could upset the world power balance in the first of a two-part episode.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bunker, Pt. 2
programme.desc: While trying to free a nuclear scientist and his wife from enemy hands, the IMF is trapped when a would-be assassin takes over one of Rollin's disguises in Part 2.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Nitro
programme.desc: The IMF finds itself only a second away from eternity when they intercept a nitroglycerine expert who plans to blow up the government house of a small country, thus provoking war with its neighbor nation.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Vault
programme.desc: Guest star Nehemiah Persoff as a corrupt Latin American official plots to loot his own country of $40,000,000 with the connivance of the IMF.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Nicole
programme.desc: Guest star Joan Collins, as a seductive double agent, endangers a vital IMF project when Jim Phelps falls in love with her.

programme.title: Burying The Ex
programme.desc: Max er en veldig hyggelig fyr. Hans søte kjæreste Evelyn viser seg å være et kontrollerende og manipulerende mareritt så snart de flytter sammen. Max vet det er på tide å gjøre det slutt, men er livredd for å slå opp med henne.

programme.title: A Time to Dance
programme.desc: John og Abby er i ferd med å gå fra hverandre, men bestemmer seg for å utsette det når de finner ut at datteren deres skal gifte seg. Mens de planlegger bryllupet, oppdager de motvillig at forholdet kanskje ikke er helt over likevel.

programme.title: The Burning Plain
programme.desc: En mor og datter forsøker å bygge et bånd etter den unge kvinnens utfordrende barndom.

programme.title: Reaching for the Moon
programme.desc: En kronikk om det tragiske kjærlighetsforholdet mellom den amerikanske poeten Elizabeth Bishop og den brasilianske arkitekten Lota de Macedo Soares.

programme.title: Youth in Revolt
programme.desc: Michael Cera (SUPERBAD) spiller Nick Twisp. En unik, men elskverdig tenåring med en smak for de sofistikerte tingene i livet. Han forelsker seg i den nydelige og intelligente Sheeni Saunders (Portia Doubleday) på campingferie med familien.

programme.title: The Lunchbox
programme.desc: I Mumbais travle hverdag bringer en feil levert lunsj to meget forskjellige skjebner sammen. Den litt stillfarende enkemannen Saajan mottar ved en feil lunsjen som husmoren Ila har laget til sin mann. Det blir starten på et utrolig eventyr.

programme.title: Odd Man Rush
programme.desc: Odd Man Rush er basert på Bill Keenans bestselgende, komiske selvbiografi af samme navn. Den amerikanske ishockeyspiller Bobby Sanders fra Harvard blir solgt til en div. 1. klubb i Sverige for en vaskemaskin.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en skikkelig filmfrik som eier en liten videobutikk. Når han ikke sitter som naglet fast foran fjernsynsapparatet og en eller annen film noir, diskuterer han film med de to medarbeiderne sine, supernerden Lucien og den noe mer stabile Jonathan.

programme.title: 10 Things we should do before we break up
programme.desc: Den kvelden da Abigail, enslig mor til to små barn, møter Ben på en bar, lager de på fleip en liste over ting å gjøre før et tenkt brudd, enda de godt vet at de aldri kommer til å innlede noe forhold engang.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Magikeren Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er skeptisk til alt som kan karakteriseres som "overnaturlig", men når han møter den forførende spåkvinnen Sophie Baker (Emma Stone), oppdager han en verden hinsides fysikkens lover.

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Symmetry
programme.desc: Johnny has trouble keeping track of his identity when visions from an attacker, a victim and a rescuer confuse the psychic's sense of reality.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Uncle Simon
programme.desc: Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Four O'Clock
programme.desc: Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means, he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.

programme.title: Hellraiser: Deader
programme.desc: Amy Klein er en tøff reporter som jobber for en hemmelig avis som leder henne til en mystisk kult som kan true livet hennes. Dette spennende neste kapittelet i HELLRAISER-franchisen er enda et helvetesmareritt du aldri vil glemme.

programme.title: Hellraiser: Hellworld
programme.desc: Når fem beinharde online gamere blir invitert til en spesiell fest, arrangert av en mystisk destinasjon, kjent som Hellworld, går de gjennom en natt med usigelig terror som når lengre enn internett.

programme.title: Hellraiser: Hellseeker
programme.desc: Pinhead er tilbake i det neste grøssende kapittelet av den spennende HELLRAISER-serien fra den bestselgende skrekkforfatteren (or regissøren av den originale filmen) Clive Barker.

programme.title: Popeye's Revenge
programme.desc: Tara og seks venner vil gjøre Popeye-huset om til et spøkelseshus. Etter en helg på camping innser de at legenden er sann. Når tåken kommer, vender Popeye tilbake for å ta Tara og drepe alle andre.

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Ascent
programme.desc: In the continuation of the episode "Descent," an unexpected incident leads Johnny to a new understanding of Walt.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Game of Pool
programme.desc: Championship pool player Fats Brown returns from the grave for one last game.

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Finding Rachel - Part 1
programme.desc: Johnny becomes the prime suspect in a case involving a missing woman and is confronted by her sister (Sarah Wynter), who clamors for his arrest.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Noen har ført kjærligheten din til oppfølgerne for langt! Favorittkomirollene til Scary Movie er tilbake i en film som skremmer opp enda mer ærbødig moro enn originalen med sitt syn på klisjéhjemsøkte thrillere.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric
programme.desc: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Denouement
programme.desc: In the thrilling series finale, Johnny's visions of Walt lead to a shocking discovery about Johnny's dad as secrets from the past are revealed.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Brain Center at Whipple's
programme.desc: A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish
programme.desc: An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

programme.title: The Dead Zone: Switch
programme.desc: After Johnny boards a train for some much-needed relaxation, he has a vision of a woman thrown to her death and soon falls for the intriguing beauty.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Five Characters in Search of an Exit
programme.desc: A hobo, clown, bagpipe player, ballerina and military officer are trapped in a huge cylinder.
programme.sub-title: Five Characters in Search of an Exit

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Most Unusual Camera
programme.desc: When three dum-dum crooks get ahold of a camera that takes pictures of the future, they set out to make a quick fortune with their new toy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Queen of the Nile
programme.desc: Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Da Bomb
programme.desc: Team Scorpion har i oppgave å hjelpe NASAs topphemmelige rakettoppskyting, men de må sabotere sitt eget oppdrag når Walters date fra forrige kveld har en bombe festet til brystet hennes.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Fractured
programme.desc: Etter at et kraftig jordskjelv rammer Los Angeles, må Team Scorpion fikse en fastklemt gassledning for å forhindre en massiv eksplosjon.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Adaptation
programme.desc: Mens Team Scorpion jobber for å stoppe en tilstrømning av narkotika som blir smuglet inn i landet via droner, gir Walter Happy og Toby et ultimatum for deres nye forhold.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: The Fast and the Nerdiest
programme.desc: Teamet må infiltrere en eksklusiv bilsmuglingsoperasjon som er i ferd med å sende biovåpen til Sør-Amerika.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Ticker
programme.desc: Når blodforsyningen til Los Angeles blir hacket og ansett som ubrukelig, må Team Scorpion finne den skyldige og redde en ung jente som desperat trenger en hjertetransplantasjon.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Djibouti Call
programme.desc: Cabe blir tatt til fange under et hemmelig oppdrag i Djibouti sammen med sin nye Homeland-protégé Tim Armstrong, og Team Scorpion må redde ham.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Twist and Shout
programme.desc: Team Scorpions oppdrag for redde restene av falne marinesoldater i Vietnam er truet sammen med livet deres når en dødelig tornado kommer direkte mot dem.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Hard Knox
programme.desc: Teamet blir hyret av forsvarsdepartementet for å bryte seg inn i Fort Knox og "stjele" en dyrebar gjenstand for å teste sikkerheten deres.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Chernobyl Intentions
programme.desc: Team Scorpion drar til Tsjernobyl for å reparere den forefallende atomreaktoren før en katastrofal nedsmelting, men må også redde Sylvester og Paige når de blir fanget inne.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Toby or Not Toby
programme.desc: Team Scorpion må være smartere enn deres ustabile eks-Scorpion-medlem, Mark Collins, etter at han kidnapper Toby og truer med å drepe ham med mindre hans utspekulerte krav blir oppfylt.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: More Civil War
programme.desc: Team Scorpion må legge problemene til side når anonyme hackere med ukjente motiver tar kontroll over amerikanske militærfly og krigsskip og retter våpen mot amerikanske byer.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: It Isn't the Fall That Kills You
programme.desc: Akkurat i det teamet gjør fremskritt mot hackerne som kontrollerer amerikanske krigsskip, får de vite at en amerikansk atomubåt også er blitt hacket.
programme.sub-title: It Isn't the Fall That Kills You

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Little Boy Lost
programme.desc: Når Walter ved et uhell blir skutt ut i verdensrommet i en rakett, hallusinerer han om Paige mens oksygenet hans går tom, og Team Scorpion jobber febrilsk for å finne en måte å få ham hjem før han blir kvalt.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Little Boy Lost
programme.desc: Teamet må finne en gutt fra Ralphs klasse som forsvinner på en ekskursjon etter å ha støtt på en dødelig forbryter.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Bat Poop Crazy
programme.desc: Team Scorpions enkle jobb ved Natural History Museum i Los Angeles blir dødelig når de oppdager tyver som raner en utstilling med sjeldne edelstener for å berike en atombombe.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: We're Gonna Need a Bigger Vote
programme.desc: Før Halloween må teamet infiltrere et dypt, enormt hulesystem for å hindre en flaggermusbestand i å ødelegge det nordamerikanske økosystemet.
programme.sub-title: We're Gonna Need a Bigger Vote

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Sly and the Family Stone
programme.desc: På valgdagen, når demokratiet står på spill, blir Team Scorpion kalt inn når noen prøver å skape kaos i det amerikanske presidentvalget.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Mother Load
programme.desc: Når Team Scorpion reiser til Irland for Megans ettårsjubileum, oppdager Walter at en naturkatastrofe i en innsjø i nærheten har skapt en giftig sky som kan drepe alle i landsbyen.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: This Is the Pits
programme.desc: Paiges mor verver Team Scorpion når hun ved et uhell oppdager en glemt atomreaktor i ferd med å eksplodere.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Wreck the Halls
programme.desc: Walter må svømme gjennom de dødelige La Brea-tjæregropene mens teamet hjelper en kvinne som sitter fast i tjæren før hun går tom for oksygen.

programme.title: Scorpion NO: Wreck the Halls
programme.desc: Det er julaften og Team Scorpions elektronikkfrie ferie på fjellet blir dødelig når de støter på våpensmuglere og Ralph blir kidnappet mens de prøver å rømme.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 501
programme.desc: Louise og Jonas fra Viborg drømmer stort, men drømmen faller i bakken med et brak. Ekspertene må jobbe hardt før den lille familien - forhåpentligvis - kan flytte inn i drømmehuset.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 502
programme.desc: Anita og Martins to barn har tatt over hjemmet, og det er leker overalt. Løsningen er et større hjem, men paret har ikke klart å finne det rette huset enda. Nå får de hjelp av ekspertene, men det blir ikke lett.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 503
programme.desc: Tina og Danni solgte rekkehuset sitt i den tro at de snart skulle finne det rette huset. Men sånn gikk det ikke. Paret er utrolig kresne, og har høye krav. Kan ekspertene skape hjemmet som Tina og Danni drømmer om?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 504
programme.desc: Laura og Jesper og Jespers to barn leier i Humlebæk, og de er mildt sagt lei av det. De mangler plass, hage - og de vil også ha barn sammen snart. Men to års husjakt har ikke gitt resultat.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 505
programme.desc: Ulla og Kristian bor i en vakker herskapsleilighet på Frederiksberg med sine to barn. Men de vil ha mer plass i et barnevennlig nabolag, innom sykkelavstand fra sentrum. Kan Tobias Edlev-Nielsen finne et hus til dem?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 506
programme.desc: En liten leiebolig i Vanløse og to små barn - ikke den beste kombinasjonen. Lisa og Erling drømmer om et stort hus med en stor hage. Tobias må jobbe hardt, da drømmene er mye større enn budsjettet.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark
programme.desc: Kristian drømmer om en diger garasje, og Nathja vil heller bli i Køge – kan Tobias oppfylle drømmene sine?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark
programme.desc: Maja og Kenneth bor på Vestjylland og drømmer om å komme nærmere familien til Maja i Silkeborg. Men budsjettet deres krever at de går på akkord med beliggenheten og ser i de nærliggende små byene.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 603
programme.desc: I Ikast er Camilla og Marc sultne på et hus med plass til oppbevaring. Men når Tobias finner et stort hus til dem, mister de motet, da det nå er SÅ mange rom som må pusses opp...

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 604
programme.desc: Stine og Daniel lengter etter mer plass før de snart utvider familien fra tre til fire. Derfor er det ikke optimalt når Mads ringer og forteller at avtalen med det nye huset deres i Langå ikke gjelder.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 301
programme.desc: Astrid og Steffen skal kjøpe sitt første hus, men de kan ikke gå på kompromiss med ønskene sine. De møter programmets eksperter som skal kjøpe et hus på deres vegne.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 302
programme.desc: Louise og Michael har vokst ut av sin lille leilighet i Århus og trenger mer plass. Paret gjør et kompromiss, og Louise står overfor sitt største mareritt i huset som ekspertene kjøper til dem.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 303
programme.desc: Charlotte og Mikkel bor i en så liten leilighet at dusjen må tømmes for ting hver gang de skal bade. Men nå ønsker de å flytte litt ut av byen sammen med sønnen deres.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 304
programme.desc: Pernille og Nicklas fra Odense bor så lite at hvis de trenger litt privatliv, så har de bare toalettet å ty til. Nicklas drømmer om å få et kjøkken med to ovner, slik at han kan lage mer mat.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 305
programme.desc: Wendy og Jesper fra Kalundborg bor allerede bra, i en leilighet som har en utrolig utsikt. Men en kommende familieforøkelse betyr at de må finne noe som er større.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 306
programme.desc: Jonas og Louise får sjokk når de ser hvilke hus de har råd til. Mads Mikkelsen og Tobias Edlev Nielsen jobber overtid for å prøve å oppfylle parets ønsker.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Jokkmokk
programme.desc: Far above the Arctic Circle, Tareq explores the wild country around Jokkmokk. Here, the Sami people lived from what the land provides for thousands of years. This wild cuisine is as extreme as the weather here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland
programme.desc: For hundreds of years, Åland’s shipping fleet was the envy of navies around the world, and their sea trade was encouraged by the seafood, grains and fruits that thrive on these islands. Tareq prepares recipes to reflect Åland’s unique cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö
programme.desc: Tareq is in his hometown of Malmö – Sweden’s third largest city. The food scene here is inspired by the traditional seafood dishes and the large immigrant population whose recipes have given Malmö a new energy.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Finland's South Coast
programme.desc: Tareq takes a late autumn trip along Finland’s southern coast. He stops in the capital Helsinki to see how the city's food culture is about to be discovered by the rest of the world, and dives into the freezing waters around Ekenäs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kiruna
programme.desc: Tareq arrives in Kiruna, over 200km north of the Arctic Circle. With the weather getting down to -30C, Tareq takes part in snow picnics, firing up the smoker, and using snow and ice as part of the recipes he prepares.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bergen
programme.desc: Surrounded by some of the most beautiful landscapes in northern Europe, Bergen has become a centre for the finest seafood in northern Europe. Tareq heads into this winter wonderland to see the curious cuisine that has developed in western Norway.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Faroe Islands
programme.desc: Tareq comes to understand what is in the soul of the Faroese, and why their cuisine has developed the way it has. We explore the beautiful capital Torshavn and surrounding villages, and sail into a cave for a recipe prepared on a rowboat.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Central Jutland
programme.desc: Volcanoes and glaciers shaped this part of the country, leaving a giant fjord and pre-historic fossils in their wake. Farmers and food innovators work closely with nature to prepare food with the area’s plentiful herbs and award-winning seafood.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: When the team foils a robbery of an armored car full of Federal Reserve money and recover bills that trace back to the infamous D.B. Cooper heist, they call on Agent Roger Bloom, who worked on the Cooper case, for help with the investigation.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Don and the team try their luck at investigating the theft of scratch-off lottery tickets, but the stakes are raised when one of the culprits killed at a botched robbery turns out to be a former lottery winner.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team searches for a lost shipment of high-caliber firearms when one of the weapons is responsible for random killings throughout the city. Also, Charlie and Amita disagree on a wedding date while Don re-evaluates his relationship with Robin.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team searches for a serial killer who is targeting men who solicit prostitutes. Also, Colby and Nikki deal with the aftermath of a car crash when they have an accident during the investigation.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team gets a taste of the limelight when they search for jewels worth millions that have been stolen during an awards show broadcast. Also, Don revisits an old case that is haunting him, and Larry returns from his adventure in the desert.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: The team investigates the deaths of two men who were part of a group of friends that had been sexually assaulted by a teacher when they were young boys.

programme.title: Numb3rs
programme.desc: Charlie and Amita get married and begin preparations for their London adventure, but they put a slight hold on their plans when they assist Don to track down the whereabouts of his gun after it goes missing, on the sixth season finale.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Pilot
programme.desc: I premiereepisoden prøver Don å fakke en serievoldtektsmann som har begynt å drepe ofrene sine. Don rekrutterer Charlie for å hjelpe til med å spore opp morderen.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Sabotasje
programme.desc: Mens de etterforsker en godstogulykke med dødelig utfall, avslører Don og Charlie en sjokkerende gjerningsperson som er ute etter å redusere publikums tillit til jernbanesystemet.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Vektor
programme.desc: Da folk i Los Angeles dør på mystisk vis, blir Don og FBI-teamet kalt inn av Folkehelseinstituttet for å finne ut om det er biologisk terror. De prøver å spore opp viruset ved hjelp av Charlies kjennskap til sykdomsmatematikk.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Usikkerhetsprinsipp
programme.desc: Da Don og teamet prøver å fakke et par bankranere i Los Angeles, lager Charlie en ligning ved hjelp av sannsynlighet og statistisk analyse for å finne ut hvor det neste ranet vil finne sted.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Strukturell korrupsjon
programme.desc: Etter at en ingeniørstudent ved CalSci blir funnet død etter et mistenkt selvmord, overtaler Charlie Don til å sette i gang en etterforskning etter å ha lest studentens avhandling, hvor han hevder at det arkitekturisk flotte Cole Center er strukturelt ust

programme.title: Numb3rs: Hovedmistenkt
programme.desc: Da en 5 år gammel jente blir kidnappet fra bursdagsselskapet sitt, leder Don og Terry etterforskningen, men de må be Charlie om hjelp, da jentas far, Ethan, også er matematiker.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Falsk virkelighet
programme.desc: Etter at to tenåringer blir funnet drept, avdekker Don og teamet et farlig nettverk som trykker falske pengesedler.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Identitetskrise
programme.desc: Da det dukker opp ny informasjon i en gammel sak, lurer Don på om han kan ha fått feil person fengslet.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Snikskytter null
programme.desc: Don og teamet må stoppe en snikskytter som er på drapstokt i Los Angeles. For å finne snikskytteren raskest mulig, henter Don in en skarpskytterinstruktør fra Quantico (gjesteskuespiller Lou Diamond Phillips) til å hjelpe dem med saken.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Skitten bombe
programme.desc: Don må finne tyvene som stjal en bil med atomavfall før de detonerer en skitten bombe i Los Angeles.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Offer
programme.desc: Etter at en innleid IT-forsker med kontrakt med Forsvarsdepartementet blir funnet drept, blir Don og teamet kalt inn for å finne gjerningspersonen.

programme.title: Numb3rs: På kanten
programme.desc: Da en UFO blir sett farlig nær Los Angeles, ber Don Charlie om hjelp til å finne ut hvor det mystiske luftfartøyet kommer fra, og de blir overrasket når det viser seg å bli en drapsetterforskning.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Menneskejakt
programme.desc: I sesongavslutningen må Don finne to voldelige forbrytere som stakk av etter at fangetransporten deres havnet i en ulykke.

programme.title: Numb3rs: Snikmorder
programme.desc: Don og teamet finner en mistenkelig kode under en razzia, og Charlie slår fast at den er en del av en hemmelig plan om å drepe en colombianer som lever i eksil i Los Angeles.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Magikeren Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er skeptisk til alt som kan karakteriseres som "overnaturlig", men når han møter den forførende spåkvinnen Sophie Baker (Emma Stone), oppdager han en verden hinsides fysikkens lover.

programme.title: Dick Dynamite 1944
programme.desc: Mot slutten av krigen planlegger nazister å gjøre New Yorks befolkning til zombier. Bare DICK DYNAMITE kan stoppe dem – drap er hans jobb, og i ’44 går forretningene strålende.

programme.title: Perversion Story
programme.desc: En samvittighetsløs lege blir anklaget for å ha drept sin astmatiske kone som en del av en forsikringssvindel – til tross for at han oppdager at hun har en dobbeltgjenger som jobber som stripper og eskortepike.

programme.title: Silver Saddle
programme.desc: En ung gutt som ser faren sin bli skutt ned, hevner seg ved å drepe leiemorderen. År senere har han vokst opp til å bli en suksessrik dusørjeger, fryktet av mange. Men en dag avsløres hemmeligheter fra fortiden hans…

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Wings of Desire aka Der Himmel über Berlin

programme.title: Ghost Town
